title: Koyla
desc: Shankar, a mute servant, tricks Gauri into marrying his employer with a false photo. But Gauri falls for Shankar, fighting against odds to be with him.

title: Ankhiyon Ke Jharokhon Se
desc: College rivals Lily and Arun fall in love with their parents' support, but their dreams shatter when she is diagnosed with leukaemia, testing their strength and bond.

title: Sirf Tum
desc: Deepak and Aarti fall in love through letters without ever meeting or knowing each other's address. Longing to see him, Aarti finally travels to Delhi to search for her true love.

title: Run
desc: Jhanvi and Siddharth are deeply in love, but her brother Ganpat, a gangster, disapproves of their relationship and plots to kill Siddharth.

title: Sky Force
desc: India and Pakistan engage in escalating airstrikes. Amid deadly consequences, individuals seek the truth behind the war, navigating chaos, patriotism, and survival in times of conflict.

title: Ground Zero
desc: BSF officer Dubey leads a two-year probe into the 2001 Parliament attack, uncovering Ghazi Baba as the mastermind and triggering India's biggest anti-terror operation.

title: Article 15
desc: Senior police officer Ayaan Ranjan has to come to grips with the reality of caste discrimination in the rural heartlands of India when a gruesome and unjust rape and murder case lands on his desk.

title: Krrish
desc: Krrish, gifted with superhuman powers, falls for Priya and travels to Singapore, where shocking truths about his father push him to embrace destiny and fight.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: 3 A.M.
desc: Sunny, Raj and Cyrus attempt a ghost-hunting reality show at a haunted site, but their plan spirals into terror as real supernatural forces strike, leading to deadly consequences.

title: Muqabla (1993)
desc: Two brother police officers, Suraj and Deepak, clash when Deepak sides with a suspect arrested by Suraj. A widow seeks justice for her husband's murder in this tense tale.

title: Judaai
desc: Driven by greed, Kajal urges her honest husband Raj to marry his boss's wealthy daughter Janhvi, but her plan triggers unforeseen consequences that threaten their lives.

title: The Hero: Love Story Of A Spy
desc: Arun, an Indian spy, falls for Reshma. When she disappears during a mission, he vows revenge and sets out to punish those responsible.

title: Bharat
desc: During the India-Pakistan partition, Bharat is separated from his family and left to care for those who remain. He spends his life trying to uphold the promise he made to his father.

title: Sam Bahadur
desc: Sam Manekshaw, one of India's most decorated army officers, served for over four decades, fought five wars, and became the first Indian officer to be promoted to Field Marshal.

title: Parmanu: The Story Of Pokhran
desc: Ashwat, an IAS officer, secretly leads a nuclear project. But he must hide everything from American intelligence to make the mission successful and safe.

title: Hogi Pyaar Ki Jeet
desc: Two brothers reunite to avenge their father's humiliation and murder by Thakur, plotting to marry his daughters as part of a calculated plan to settle scores.
